Fatima Al-Rashidi, a Backend Engineer at NexaGame Studios, consistently delivers high-impact solutions with precision and reliability.  

Her Kubernetes expertise reshaped the company’s deployment strategy, reducing cluster downtime by 40% and enabling scalable microservices architecture for their flagship game. She designed a PostgreSQL sharding solution that cut query latency by 35%, directly improving server responsiveness during peak user loads. These systems now handle 2M+ requests daily, with near-zero error rates.  

Fatima’s CI/CD pipelines, built with GitHub Actions and Docker, streamlined deployment cycles from 4 hours to 15 minutes. She also implemented Prometheus/Grafana dashboards that cut monitoring latency by 60%, ensuring real-time visibility into critical metrics. Her Terraform modules standardized infrastructure provisioning across 12 environments, saving 200+ hours annually in setup and maintenance.  

A self-driven problem-solver with an eye for detail, Fatima thrives in complex, high-stakes environments. Her ability to balance technical rigor with clear communication makes her a trusted collaborator and a strategic asset.
